title: Swear the Rune-Mountain Hall: Key Verdict
description: Swear the Rune-Mountain Hall: Key Verdict is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet through The Thunder-Oath Gate (Ruin Gate with active oath memory). One selected deity from Odin, Freyja, Frigg, Thor enters; this beat spotlights Odin as the reference silhouette while preserving player choice. The mission is the elite step at Rune-Mountain Hall, using storm bridge and world-root trial pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow..
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Rune-Mountain Hall and reveals: A damaged inscription showing the Gate can bind gods as well as monsters. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Rune-Mountain Hall configured as a elite space inside storm bridge and world-root trial; source-culture appearance layer: rune-storm bridges, oath-stone courts, Bifrost storm fractures, Yggdrasil root ramps, Valhalla shieldwall ruins; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: rune-iron oath axes, stormsteel wolf-cloak mail, Yggdrasil thunder-root cores, Valkyrie witness counters
